decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) are used).

Condition : 5 - The extension to No. 4 Charter Crescent hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any other time that for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 4 Charter Crescent, and the extension to No. 6 Charter Crescent hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any other time that for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 6 Charter Crescent.

Condition : 6 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the southeastern flank wall of the extension hereby approved to No. 4 Charter Crescent and in the northwestern or southeastern flank wall of the extension hereby approved to No. 6 Charter Crescent without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - No part of the roof of the single-storey rear extension hereby approved to No. 6 Charter Crescent shall be used as or altered to form a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.

Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding the above, the alterations to the existing front porches to No.s 4 and 6 Charter Crescent hereby approved shall be completed within two months of the date of the permission.
description: ERECTION OF TWO-STOREY SIDE EXTENSION TO DWELLINGHOUSE AT NO. 4 CHARTER CRESCENT AND ERECTION OF TWO-STOREY SIDE AND PART SINGLE-STOREY REAR EXTENSION TO DWELLINGHOUSE AT NO. 6 CHARTER CRESCENT
